quotes.summary_phrase: Patrick Beverley on his defensive philosophy
quotes.excerpt: I was with a coach who leaned a lot on principles defensively. And for me, principles don't work.
quotes.quote: I was with a coach who leaned a lot on principles defensively. And for me, principles don't work. Because if I'm playing you, and if I'm playing Kyle Lowry, and I'm playing DeMar DeRozan, if I'm going over the screen all the time, y'all okay, cool, I know I'm going to do that next. Right. So, what I did know is when I got to the playoffs, the coach is like, okay, do whatever you want now. And I'm like, oh shit, all right, bet. Say less. My approach was like, okay, cool, I'm going to go under, under, over. That's what always I put in my head. I'm going to go my first three plays, I'm going to go under, under, over. I'm not giving you over and hitting the paint. I'm going to give you under three. Let's see if you can make that first.
